summary: Share effective work state calculation with lazy dependency providers

replay.detail: Existing Store readers use the same SQL sources and evaluation order. No replay, backfill or source registration is introduced.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger or derived table changes.

rules.detail: Owner, generation, root, person request, blocker and lease semantics are preserved in one shared calculator. No action, admission or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Public work presentation and effect fencing are unchanged. The internal input trait lets future keyed consumers reuse the calculation after certifying their sources.

downtime.detail: No restart or startup recovery work is added.

manual.detail: No operator action required. Future alternative input providers must explicitly reject unknown dependency coverage before evaluation.

recovery.detail: Existing recovery and rollback behavior is unchanged; no persisted state is added.
